## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design secure, scalable upgrade workflows across tenants with provenance, policy enforcement, and rollback.

## Key Concepts
- Image provenance with Cosign + KMS
- SBOM delta verification per tenant
- Kyverno policy gates + attestation
- Canary rollout with per-tenant windows
- Observability and audit logging

## Code Example
```yaml
# Example Kyverno policy snippet (high-level)
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: cnf-upgrade-gate
spec:
  rules:
  - name: require-sbom-and-attestation
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: [Deployment]
    validate:
      message: "SBOM and attestation required"
      pattern:
        spec:
          template:
            metadata:
              annotations:
                provenance: ?
```

## Why This Is Asked
Assesses ability to design end-to-end supply chain security and runtime integrity for multi-cloud CNFs, including identity management, attestation mechanisms, policy-as-code enforcement, and network isolation during zero-downtime upgrades.

## Key Concepts
- SPIFFE/SPIRE identity management
- TPM/IMA runtime attestation
- SPDX SBOM delta validation
- OPA/Kyverno policy enforcement
- Cilium eBPF network policies
- Canary upgrade strategies

## Code Example
```yaml
# SPIFFE identity configuration
apiVersion: spiffe.example/v1
kind: SPIFFEIdentity
metadata:
  name: cnf-identity-01
spec:
  spiffeID: spiffe://cluster/ns/cnf-01
  parentID: spiffe://cluster/ns/workload-scheduler
  ttl: 1h
```

```yaml
# OPA upgrade gate policy
package cnf.upgrade
default allow = false

allow {
  input.attestation.trust_score >= 80
  input.sbom.delta.additions == 0
  input.network_policy.isolated == true
}
```

## Implementation Approach
The solution integrates identity, attestation, and policy enforcement to ensure upgrades maintain security posture while achieving zero downtime through controlled canary deployments.

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to implement multi-tenant zero-trust mTLS using SPIFFE IDs, short-lived cert rotation, and KMS-backed CA in CNF gateways.

## Key Concepts
- SPIFFE/SPIRE trust domains per tenant
- CSR-based certificate rotation with short lifetimes
- Per-tenant mesh policies (Istio/OPA) for north-south and east-west traffic
- Workload identity verification via SPIFFE IDs

## Code Example
```yaml
# CSR bootstrap (outline)
apiVersion: certificates.k8s.io/v1
kind: CertificateSigningRequest
metadata:
  name: gateway-td1-csr
spec:
  signerName: kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-clientSigner
  request: <base64-csr>
  usages:
  - digital signature
  - key encipherment
  - client auth
```

```yaml
# Per-tenant policy (outline)
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-td1-gateway
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
  rules:
  - from:
    - source:
        principals: ["spiffe://td1/ns/default/sa/gateway"]
    to:
    - operation:
        methods: ["GET","POST"]
```

- How would you test cross-tenant isolation under peak load?

Why This Is Asked

```yaml
# ConstraintTemplate: defines RateLimitTemplate for K8sRateLimit
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: k8sratelimittemplate
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: K8sRateLimit
  targets:
  - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh
    rego: |
      package k8sratelimit
      # Pseudocode: reads per-namespace cnf.rate-limit and enforces a per-minute cap
      defaultRate := 100
      rateLimitPerMin := data.rateLimitPerMin
      # implementation would map namespace to rate and count requests
      # returns deny if burst exceeds rate
```

```yaml

apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: K8sRateLimit
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-rate-limit
spec:
  match:
    kinds:
    - apiGroups: [""]
      kinds: ["Namespace"]
  parameters:
    rateLimitPerMin: 200
    targetPath: "/gateway"
```

```yaml
apiVersion: cnf.example/v1
kind: TenantUpgradePolicy
```
